facts.label: Cheats
facts.value: 61 cheats, post-story only — using one disables trophies and saving

stages.key: Story first — play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals on the way; the counters for Whip It Good and the 100% list start counting now.
stages.name: Stage 1 — The Story
steps: Play Chapters 1–5 and the final mission (17 story trophies, all unmissable).
Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot when offered at home — it may be missable.
Finish the five character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as they appear.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.

stages.key: After the credits, work through the 100% Completion checklist (Progress, then Stats). Earlier progress counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx notes the checklist is really about 60% true completion.
stages.name: Stage 2 — 100% Completion
steps: Open the 100% Completion checklist and work it line by line (table below).
Grind the big counters: 300 stunts, 42 range golds, 42 drone races, 70 challenges.
Finish the collectibles: 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 50 weapons.
Rob all 8 vaults and all 39 gang operations; meditate at 15 of the 18 spots.

stages.key: Mop up what is left: the activities, the partner and robbery trophies, the money trophies and the five unconfirmed hidden trophies. Then the platinum pops.
stages.name: Stage 3 — Cleanup
steps: Try every activity type and finish the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy).
Launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy the 8 garages, register 10 vehicles.
Hunt with Bret, bowl with the Kingpin crew, max Strength for both leads.
Check the five unconfirmed trophies — their triggers are still being cracked.
